record.hypothesis: The source transport contains one H.264 stream and two AAC tracks. Rebuilding the TS with only video + first audio preserves all 150 video packet payload hashes and all 236 selected-audio payload hashes. The unused 236 AAC packets are absent. Transport size falls from 345,920 to 281,248 bytes, a 18.7% reduction. This validates a payload-preserving track-pruning route; the TS container itself must still be rebuilt because PAT/PMT/PID/PCR/continuity semantics belong to the output transport.
